This procedure details the testing procedures and calibration I1, which 
recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by Y1 in the title block

This procedure details the steps required to completely 
check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. The relay must be 
tested every year. This relay is a negative phase sequence time over 
current relay used primarily to protect generators against the effect of phase 
fault or unbalance load.

Since the relay is protecting the generator from damage 
caused by fault on the system rather than from internal fault ,it is providing 
essential back up protection .the heating effected on the rotor of synchrouns 
machine caused by unbalance currents can best be expressed as function of the 
negative phase sequence current and of time.

The first draft initiated by Eng. Reda El Shenawey, tested 
by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa , and accepted by 
general manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
 document is revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il: MDEPC quality control general director, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

Look at field maintenance file and 
 compare the setting on relay with those shown on the test sheet.
Check DC. Circuit for Over Current Relay.

Connect test leads between the current 
 terminals ( 3 4 ) on the relay.

Connect test leads between the trip 
 terminals ( 1 2 ) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set.

Increase the current slowly until the 
 relay energize and regist (P.U) value .

Decrease the current slowly until the 
 relay denergize and regist (REST) value.

Increase the current again to (P.U) 
 value
Stop the test set .

Restart the test set (current = P.U 
 value ).

The relay will operate , the timer will 
 account and stop when the trip contact close.
Regist the time value.

Record 
 these values in the test sheet.

Connect test leads between the current 
 terminals ( 5 6 ) on the relay.

Repeat steps from ( 2 to 10 ) 
 for phase ( S ) .

Connect test leads between the current 
 terminals ( 7 8 ) on the relay.

Repeat steps from ( 2 to 10 ) 
 for phase ( T ) .
